<div class="row heroPanel__body">
<div class="col-12 col-lg-9">
<h1 class="heroPanel__title">Creating impact from science and engineering </h1>
<p class="heroPanel__copy">Our world-leading measurement solutions are critical to business and government, accelerating research and innovation, improving quality of life and enabling trade.  We ensure our cutting-edge measurement science has a positive impact in the real world. 
</p><p> </p>
LONDON LIVE: Hot Topics<br/>

Find out how NPL is improving life for everyone<p></p>
</div>
<div class="col-12"></div>

<div class="contentRow" id="p_lt_ctl04_pageplaceholder_p_lt_ctl00_ContentRow_C_CRO1_pnlMain">

<div class="container">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-12" id="p_lt_ctl04_pageplaceholder_p_lt_ctl00_ContentRow_C_CRO1_div2ColMainHeading">
<h2 class="contentRow__title contentRow__title--large">
                        Excellent science 
                    </h2>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="container">
<div class="row" id="p_lt_ctl04_pageplaceholder_p_lt_ctl00_ContentRow_C_CRO1_pnlRow">
<div class="col-12 col-md-6" id="p_lt_ctl04_pageplaceholder_p_lt_ctl00_ContentRow_C_CRO1_pnlLeftColumn">
<div class="contentRow__content">
<p>As the UK's National Measurement Institute, NPL develops and maintains the national primary measurement standards. From new antibiotics to tackle resistance and more effective cancer treatments to unhackable quantum communications and superfast 5G, technological advances must be built on a foundation of reliable measurement to succeed. </p>
<p>For over a century, we have worked with customers to translate scientific expertise into economic prosperity, skilled employment and improved quality of life. </p>
<p> </p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-12 col-md-6" id="p_lt_ctl04_pageplaceholder_p_lt_ctl00_ContentRow_C_CRO1_pnlRightColumn">

<h2 class="imageRow__title">National challenges</h2>
<p class="imageRow__text">Using our expertise to help you make a difference to some of the biggest challenges in industry, energy, environment and healthcare. </p>
<a class="imageRow__link" href="/national-challenges" id="p_lt_ctl04_pageplaceholder_p_lt_ctl00_CTAImageRowPanel_hlButton1">National challenges</a>

</div>

<div class="contentRow__content">
<p>We help save lives, protect the environment and enable citizens to feel safe and secure, as well as supporting international trade and commercial innovation.</p>
<p>As a national laboratory, our advice is always impartial and independent, meaning consumers, investors, policymakers and entrepreneurs can always rely on the work we do.</p>
<p> </p>
</div>

<h2 class="imageRow__title">London Live</h2>
<p class="imageRow__text">From air quality and cancer treatment to robots and driver-less cars, the technology is exciting, dynamic and fascinating.  London Live visited NPL to see some of our activities and understand how important measurement is.</p>

<h2 class="imageRow__title">Fugitive emissions</h2>
<p class="imageRow__text">NPL offers a complete solution for monitoring your fugitive emissions. Our controlled release testing facility independently validates instrument accuracy, ensures national traceability and improves performance.</p>
<a class="imageRow__link" href="/campaigns/fugitive-emissions" id="p_lt_ctl04_pageplaceholder_p_lt_ctl00_2CTAImageRowPanel1_hlButton2">Fugitive emissions</a>

<script type="text/javascript">
    function openTab(evt, tabName) {
        // Declare all variables
        var i, tabcontent, tablinks;

        // Get all elements with class="tabcontent" and hide them
        tabcontent = document.getElementsByClassName("tabPanel__content");
        for (i = 0; i < tabcontent.length; i++) {
            tabcontent[i].style.display = "none";
        }

        // Get all elements with class="tablinks" and remove the class "active"
        tablinks = document.getElementsByClassName("tabPanel__tab");
        for (i = 0; i < tablinks.length; i++) {
            tablinks[i].classList.remove("active");
        }

        // Show the current tab, and add an "active" class to the button that opened the tab
        document.getElementById(tabName).style.display = "block";
        evt.currentTarget.className += " active";
    }
</script>

<a class="searchResult__title" href="/Events/Advanced-Engineering-Show">Advanced Engineering Show</a>
<div class="row">
<div class="col-12">
<p>
<span class="searchResult__date">
                                30 Oct - 31 Oct
                            </span>
<span>
</span></p><p>NPL brings measurement and engineering expertise to your organisation. Global and national trends in manufacturing like digital industrialisation, environmental concerns and energy challenges are generating new markets, products and disruptive materials and processes. As a leader in technology. We have a wide portfolio of products including:</p>
<ul>
<li><b>High-quality calibration services: </b>NPL offers a comprehensive range of services, all of which are directly traceable to the internationally recognised primary measurement standards. Our highly‑accurate measurement instruments, sensors and artefacts are designed to enhance your business.</li>
<li><b>Electronics reliability service:</b> We provide characterisation and testing for electronic components in harsh and safety critical environments, such as electric vehicles, defence applications and medical devices.</li>
<li><b>Specialist training courses</b>:  Learners will quickly make a difference within their workplaces and generate a return on training investment by improving their organisation’s measurement capability. We have new modules on composites materials.   </li>
</ul>
<p><b>Visit us at on stand G36 and find out how our products and services can advance your engineering.</b></p>

<h2 class="imageRow__title">Strategic partners</h2>
<p class="imageRow__text">We have a partnering agreement with the Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy (BEIS) and the University of Strathclyde and University of Surrey.

This strategic partnership is enabling us to work more closely with the academic community and is the basis of our Postgraduate Institute, which is creating the next generation of world-class measurement scientists.</p>
